change.title: Type one-click compensation outcomes
change.summary: Introduces a crate-internal CompensationOutcome that records Science cleanup, SSH cleanup, authority restore, prior Science restart, snapshot cleanup, and typed environment exposure. One-click compensation recovery and environment projection now derive only from those typed outcomes; compatibility diagnostic codes are rendered by typed causes and never parsed back into control flow. Existing DTO keys, coarse stages, diagnostic codes, and compensation operation ordering remain unchanged.

basis: focused transaction tests passed outside the restricted sandbox with 24 passed, zero failed, and 2 explicitly ignored
three explicit isolated compensation cleanup, restart, and diagnostic-redaction tests each passed with one passed and zero failed
complete Rust library regression passed outside the restricted sandbox with 482 passed, zero failed, and 41 explicitly ignored isolated or live-bound identities
transaction contract asserts five typed compensation step results and forbids recovery/message parsing inside the compensation helper
existing one-click DTO keys, coarse stage projection, diagnostic codes, and compensation operation ordering remain behavior-preserving
clean-context independent rereview passed with zero BLOCK, HIGH, MEDIUM, or LOW findings after repairing the prior Science disposition completeness finding
